## Diff Sourcing Note

The `2026-05-11` baseline TSV (`snapshot-sync/2026-05-11/spec-snapshot.tsv`) predates the
checksum/definition-text bulk columns entirely — `MSGDEF` rows carry only
`type/name/isoId/businessArea/status` and `MSGCOMP`/`CHOICE`/`CODESET` rows only
`type/name/isoId/status`. An initial ID-keyed comparison against that file (New/Removed by isoId
presence) was cross-validated exactly against `get_snapshot_diff` once a client-side stale-cache
issue was resolved (the `2026-05-11/2026-06-26` pair was live on the server the whole time —
confirmed by another session: `a6639eb` deployed it; this session's tool cache just hadn't picked
it up yet). All New/Removed counts below are double-confirmed by both methods. All Changed entries
are sourced from `get_snapshot_diff`'s `changedContent` section (`xsiType`-filtered for
Codesets/Components/Choices; unfiltered record-shape scan for Messages, which carry no `xsiType`)
— this is the one signal the stale baseline genuinely couldn't provide on its own.

**Every Changed entry this cycle is metadata-only** (registrationStatus graduations
Provisionally-Registered→Registered, `derivation`/`previousVersion`/`nextVersions`/
`messageSet`/`messageBuildingBlock` reference-graph churn) — `get_snapshot_diff`'s own
`changes` object reported zero changes to `definition`, `xmlTag`, `rootElement`, or field/member
lists for any of the 90 Changed items below. This directly answers the description-drift
question, not just the structural one: `definition` is explicitly absent from every one of these
90 items' changed-attribute lists, meaning the tool itself confirms their XML doc text is still
current — this was checked, not assumed. None of these 90 are expected to need a code edit.
Each is still listed as an unchecked item, and the `snapshot-sync-codesets`/`-components`/
`-choices`/`-messages` skills' own "Changed" steps (updated 2026-08-27 specifically for this) now
independently re-verify description text against a fresh `universal_lookup` call before checking
off any Changed item — belt-and-suspenders on top of this plan's own diff-based confirmation, not
a substitute for it.

**Correction found during Phase 1 processing (2026-08-27):** "metadata-only" was too strong a claim
for the two `derivation`-attribute Changed entries specifically (`SecurityStatusCode`,
`TradingVenueCode`). `get_snapshot_diff` correctly reported `definition`/`xmlTag` as unchanged for
both — but this codebase mirrors the `derivation` (Derived-By) relationship into a hand-maintained
`[Derivations(typeof(...))]` attribute on the base type, which genuinely needed editing to add the
new derived type. "No `definition` change" ≠ "no code change" whenever an attribute encodes a
*structural relationship* the diff tool tracks under a different field name than the one this plan
checked. Both real edits were made (see Phase 1 Changed section below) — flagged here so the same
class of gap gets checked for in Phases 2–4 too, not just re-confirmed as "definition unchanged and
therefore nothing to do."
